endReason: You are defeated by Dr. Pepper. From Pepperridge Farm. Because you stuck your nose into a dispute over baked goods and your campaign ends.

chronicle.text: The Host is assembled. The road to Middelalderen begins here.
chronicle.heading: The March Begins

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
The Host leaves the Starting Clearing and enters the forest road.
chronicle.heading: Forest

chronicle.text: Strange mushrooms and fungi are growing in abundance in a particular area. Some appear to be poisonous, others edible.
chronicle.heading: Poisonous Fungi

chronicle.text: Have a Unit sample the fungi?
chronicle.heading: Poisonous Fungi

choices.label: Sample the fungi
choices.detail: Choose 1 Unit, then roll 1d6. On 1, lose that Unit; otherwise gain 1 Food.

choices.label: Leave them alone
choices.detail: No effect.

chronicle.text: You choose: Sample the fungi.
Choose the Unit that samples the fungi
chronicle.heading: Poisonous Fungi

choices.label: Levy
choices.detail: 2 in Host

chronicle.text: Roll: 4.
The fungi prove edible.
Gain 1 Food.
The Host reaches a settlement held by the Quietus.
chronicle.heading: Arrival

chronicle.text: Quietus Rapport changes from Unmet to Neutral.
First Contact roll: 4 + 4 = 8.
Neither welcome nor threat greets the Host. The Quietus watch carefully and wait to see what you will do.
The terms are simple, if not generous: 3 Coin for the Quietus.
3 Coin changes hands. Whatever the Quietus think of the Host, the tribute is paid.

A row of unlit candles blocks the road, each set before a stone bearing no name. Quietus keepers ask your host to pay witness before passing, for some roads are owed to the dead before they are granted to the living.
chronicle.heading: The Candle Toll

chronicle.text: Choose an approach
chronicle.heading: The Candle Toll

choices.label: Pay Witness (8+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Rapport and 1 Leadership, then lose 1 Morale. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Ask the Keepers (9+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Research or 1 Leadership. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Pocket the Candle Silver (7+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 3 Coin and 1 Leadership. Fail: Lose 1 Rapport.

choices.label: Attack
choices.detail: Win: Gain 1 Research and 1 Leadership. Disengage: Lose 1 Morale. Enemy Host: 1P, 1A, 1I, 2L

chronicle.text: You choose: Pay Witness.
Pay Witness: Test 8+
chronicle.heading: The Candle Toll

choices.label: Spend 1 Leadership
choices.detail: Roll 3d6 and keep the best 2

chronicle.text: You attempted to Pay Witness, but failed.
Lose 1 Coin.
The Quietus offer no argument and little explanation. The answer is simply no.

There is shouting at Pepperridge Farm that draws your host’s attention. Dr. Pepper, known nearby for treating sick horses and troubled cattle, and his family are being harassed by the Crumb family, a local rival bakery, who accuse them of stealing recipes. The Crumbs offer food and silver for your backing, though your host can see well enough that both were taken from the Pepper family’s own stores.
chronicle.heading: Pepperridge Farm

chronicle.text: Advance 1 Time.
Side with the Crumb family?
chronicle.heading: Pepperridge Farm

chronicle.text: Gain 1 Food.
The Baggage Train has no room for 1 Food. Purge a carried Resource to make room, or leave the new Resource behind.
chronicle.heading: Baggage Train

choices.label: Leave 1 Food behind
choices.detail: Keep the Baggage Train as it is.

choices.label: Purge 2 Food
choices.detail: Free Baggage space 1.

choices.label: Purge 1 Wood
choices.detail: Free Baggage space 2.

choices.label: Purge 1 Stone
choices.detail: Free Baggage space 3.

choices.label: Purge 2 Food
choices.detail: Free Baggage space 4.

chronicle.text: The Host leaves 1 Food behind because the Baggage Train cannot carry it.
Gain 5 Coin.
The Host turns its attention to Work.
While the road waits, the Host takes up the work at hand: hauling, mending, tending, building, and drilling for what comes next.
chronicle.heading: Work

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
Choose Work result
chronicle.heading: Work

choices.label: Gain 2 Coin
choices.detail: Gain 2 Coin.

choices.label: Gain 1 Coin and 1 Leadership
choices.detail: Gain 1 Coin and 1 Leadership.

chronicle.text: You choose: Gain 1 Coin and 1 Leadership.
Gain 1 Coin.
Gain 1 Leadership.
Advance 2 Time.
The trees close around the column, swallowing the road a few dozen paces at a time.
chronicle.heading: Forest

chronicle.text: Brigands ambush your Host from the tree line where the path narrows, leaving no easy way to turn aside before steel is drawn.
chronicle.heading: The Bandit Horde

chronicle.text: The Host disengages after the first round.
Lose 1 Morale.
The road enters a settlement of the Quietus, where the Host is noticed long before anyone chooses to acknowledge it.
chronicle.heading: Arrival

chronicle.text: Passage has a price. The Quietus require 3 Coin before the Host proceeds.
The Host surrenders 3 Coin, and the Quietus accept the tribute.

A reliquary wagon sits abandoned but watched. Quietus keepers say its contents must not be touched by the unordained, yet they do not hide that the road ahead has dangers only the devout survive well.
chronicle.heading: Ashen Reliquary

chronicle.text: Choose an approach
chronicle.heading: Ashen Reliquary

choices.label: Ask for Blessing (8+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Leadership. Fail: Lose 1 Morale.

choices.label: Receive Instruction (9+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Research and 1 Food. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Open the Casket (7+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Research. Fail: Lose 1 Rapport.

choices.label: Attack
choices.detail: Win: Gain 1 Research and 1 Leadership. Disengage: Lose 1 Morale. Enemy Host: 1I, 5L

chronicle.text: You choose: Receive Instruction.
Receive Instruction: Test 9+
chronicle.heading: Ashen Reliquary

choices.label: Spend 1 Leadership
choices.detail: Roll 3d6 and keep the best 2

chronicle.text: Roll: 4, 4, 3 (keep best 2) = 8.
You attempted to Receive Instruction, but failed.
Lose 1 Coin.
The Quietus keepers deny your request.
A child’s careless game has set dry kindling smoldering near a granary. The danger is small now. It will not stay that way for long.
chronicle.heading: Quench the Sparks

chronicle.text: Advance 1 Time.
The fire is put out in time for grateful eyes to see it.
Gain 1 Morale.
The Host turns its attention to Raise Local Levies.
Not every man who joins the host seeks glory. Some answer because the road has reached their door.
chronicle.heading: Raise Local Levies

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
Choose Raise Local Levies result
chronicle.heading: Raise Local Levies

choices.label: Raise Levies
choices.detail: Spend 1 Food. Add 2 Levy to your Host.

choices.label: Rest
choices.detail: Gain 1 Morale.

chronicle.text: You choose: Raise Levies.
Gain 2 Levy.
Advance 2 Time.
The Host advances into open country.
chronicle.heading: Plains

chronicle.text: The miles pass quietly. Nothing on the open road demands the Host's attention.
chronicle.heading: Uneventful Travel

chronicle.text: Dark stonework and guarded approaches leave little doubt whose settlement lies ahead: the Nightstone.
chronicle.heading: Arrival

chronicle.text: Nightstone Rapport changes from Unmet to Neutral.
First Contact roll: 5 + 5 = 10.
The Nightstone keep their distance and their judgment to themselves. For now, the meeting remains civil.
The terms are simple, if not generous: 1 Research for the Nightstone.
The Host cannot provide the demanded 1 Research in full.
Without tribute, test 8+ to persuade the tribe to allow passage.
chronicle.heading: Passage

choices.label: Spend 1 Leadership
choices.detail: Roll 3d6 and keep the best 2

chronicle.text: The passage test fails.
The Nightstone refuse passage.
Lose 1 Rapport with Nightstone.
Lose 1 Morale from the shortfall.
The Host disengages and is forced onward.
The Host is forced onward before it can make camp.
Advance 2 Time.
There is no welcome behind you, only the climb ahead. The Host pushes into the high country.
chronicle.heading: Mountain

chronicle.text: Crates of wine, silk, and crossbows lie hidden in a cave. Someone didn’t want them taxed.
chronicle.heading: Smugglers’ Caves

chronicle.text: Roll: 5.
You uncover military knowledge hidden among the contraband.
Gain Longbows.
The Host reaches a settlement held by the Sun-Touched.
chronicle.heading: Arrival

chronicle.text: Sun-Touched Rapport changes from Unmet to Hostile.
First Contact roll: 1 + 2 = 3.
Whatever goodwill might have existed dies quickly. The Sun-Touched make it plain that the Host is not welcome.
The Sun-Touched demand 1 Stone in tribute.
The Host pays 1 Stone in tribute.
The tribute is accepted, but hostility remains. Test 8+ to secure passage.
chronicle.heading: Passage

choices.label: Roll 2d6
choices.detail: Rapport DRM: -1

choices.label: Spend 1 Leadership
choices.detail: Roll 3d6 and keep the best 2

chronicle.text: The passage test succeeds.
The tribute and appeal cool the immediate hostility.
Gain 1 Rapport with Sun-Touched.
A hungry settlement watches your column pass. Their wardens have stores hidden, but not enough for everyone through the season. What you take or give here will be remembered.
chronicle.heading: Last Grain Before Frost

chronicle.text: Choose an approach
chronicle.heading: Last Grain Before Frost

choices.label: Offer Relief (8+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Food and 1 Leadership. Fail: Lose 1 Food.

choices.label: Share the Burden (9+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Morale and 1 Food. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Take the Stores (7+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 2 Food. Fail: Lose 1 Rapport.

choices.label: Attack
choices.detail: Win: Gain 2 Food and 1 Leadership. Disengage: Lose 1 Morale. Enemy Host: 2A, 1I, 3L

chronicle.text: You choose: Offer Relief.
Offer Relief: Test 8+
chronicle.heading: Last Grain Before Frost

choices.label: Spend 1 Leadership
choices.detail: Roll 3d6 and keep the best 2

chronicle.text: You attempted to Offer Relief, and succeeded.
Gain 1 Food.
Gain 1 Leadership.
The Sun-Touched agree to your terms.
The spring campaign draws to a close. The Host pauses to reckon with the season behind it.
chronicle.heading: End of Spring

chronicle.text: Before the Host can settle its stores, the wider world shifts around it.
Market Vulnerability die: Food -.
The Market presses against its limit, but Food remains at 2 Coin to buy.
Barbarian Activation die: Barbarian icon.
Nightstone raiders strike the rear-most controlled settlement and seize it for themselves.
Harvest brings in 1 Wood. The new supplies are staged beside the Baggage Train before anything is packed away.
3 Terrain are cut off by Hostile settlements and produce nothing.
The Host packs 1 Wood from the new Harvest.
The road behind the Host falls out of the Chronicle: 2 Clearings and 1 Terrain card leave the active route.
End of Spring is complete.
The Host turns its attention to Work.
While the road waits, the Host takes up the work at hand: hauling, mending, tending, building, and drilling for what comes next.

choices.detail: Gain 1 Coin and 1 Leadership.

chronicle.text: You choose: Gain 2 Coin.
Gain 2 Coin.
Advance 2 Time.
The road tilts upward, and conversation thins as the climb begins to demand everyone's breath.
chronicle.heading: Mountain

chronicle.text: The climb is hard enough without adding drama. The high road offers no encounter beyond stone, wind, and tired legs.
chronicle.heading: Uneventful Travel

chronicle.text: The road opens into an unclaimed clearing. The Host takes control without resistance.
chronicle.heading: A Vacant Clearing

chronicle.text: The clearing is secure. Forage before making camp?
chronicle.heading: Arrival

choices.label: Forage
choices.detail: Advance 1 Time. On 4–6, gain 1 Resource matching the adjacent Terrain.

choices.label: Continue
choices.detail: Proceed to Camp without foraging.

chronicle.text: The Host leaves the clearing undisturbed and makes camp.
The Host turns its attention to Host a Common Table.
Bread shared in peace can carry a promise farther than a threat ever will.
chronicle.heading: Host a Common Table

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
Spend 1 Food.
Choose a Neutral or Friendly tribe
chronicle.heading: Host a Common Table

choices.label: Sun-Touched
choices.detail: Neutral • +0 DRM. Test 6+; Leadership may not be spent. Pass: gain 2 Coin, 1 Leadership, and 1 Rapport.

choices.label: Quietus
choices.detail: Neutral • +0 DRM. Test 6+; Leadership may not be spent. Pass: gain 2 Coin, 1 Leadership, and 1 Rapport.

Test 6+

choices.label: Roll 2d6
choices.detail: Rapport DRM: +0. Leadership may not be spent. Pass: gain 2 Coin and 1 Leadership; if Friendly, gain 1 additional Leadership, otherwise gain 1 Rapport.

Gain 2 Coin.
Gain 1 Leadership.
Gain 1 Rapport with Quietus.

choices.detail: Return this card to the Camp discard pile.

choices.detail: This card will not return this game.

chronicle.text: Host a Common Table is discarded.
Advance 2 Time.
The road spills onto broad plains where every distant movement looks important for a moment.
chronicle.heading: Plains

chronicle.text: Your scouts reach a high rise where open ground and distant roads can both be watched. From here, signs of what lies ahead are easier to read than from the march below.
chronicle.heading: High Overlook

chronicle.text: Choose scouting benefit
chronicle.heading: High Overlook

choices.label: Mark the Clear Road
choices.detail: Your next Explore costs 1 less Time, to a minimum of 1. When its Explore card is revealed, you may ignore that card's effect; then remove this reminder.

choices.label: Scout the Approach
choices.detail: The next time you reveal a Clearing, gain 1 Leadership if it has a Barbarian icon; otherwise gain 1 Morale.

chronicle.text: You choose: Scout the Approach.
Scouts are sent ahead to study the next approach and prepare the Host for what waits there.

chronicle.text: Gain 1 Morale.
The clearing is secure. Forage before making camp?

The search yields nothing useful.
The summer campaign draws to a close. The Host pauses to reckon with the season behind it.
chronicle.heading: End of Summer

chronicle.text: Before the Host can settle its stores, the wider world shifts around it.
Market Vulnerability die: Wood +.
The Market shifts. Wood rises from 3 to 4 Coin to buy.
Barbarian Activation die: Barbarian icon.
Nightstone raiders strike the rear-most controlled settlement and seize it for themselves.
Harvest brings in 1 Wood. The new supplies are staged beside the Baggage Train before anything is packed away.
4 Terrain are cut off by Hostile settlements and produce nothing.
The remaining 1 Wood cannot be carried and are left behind.
The road behind the Host falls out of the Chronicle: 2 Clearings and 2 Terrain cards leave the active route.
With Summer ended, the Host has a chance to Refit & Reform before the march resumes.
Recruit 2 Levy for 1 Food.
Recruit 1 Infantry for 2 Coin.
Recruit 1 Infantry for 2 Coin.
Refit & Reform is complete.
End of Summer is complete.

chronicle.text: Your host did not leave Pepperridge Farm that day as unnoticed as it had hoped. The silver taken from that quarrel is long spent, but the insult has only grown in the telling.
chronicle.heading: Pepperridge Farm Remembers
